SELECT ar.id,
    ar.created_by_user_id,
    ar.status,
    ap.user_id AS participant_user_id,
    ap.action_status AS participant_action_status,
    ap.participant_role,
    ar.request_type,
    ar.leave_type,
    ( SELECT (count(*))::integer AS count
           FROM approval_participants ap2
          WHERE ((ap2.request_id = ar.id) AND ((ap2.participant_role)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('APPROVER'::character varying)::text, ('AGREEMENTOR'::character varying)::text])) AND ((ap2.action_status)::text <> ALL (ARRAY[('PENDING'::character varying)::text, ('WAITING'::character varying)::text])))) AS reviewer_action_count
   FROM (approval_requests ar
     LEFT JOIN approval_participants ap ON (((ap.request_id = ar.id) AND ((ar.status)::text <> 'TEMPORARY'::text) AND ((ap.action_status)::text <> 'WAITING'::text))))
  WHERE (ar.is_deleted = false);

SELECT a.id,
    a.status AS asset_status,
    last_aa.id AS latest_assignment_id,
    last_aa.assignment_type AS latest_assignment_type,
    last_aa.status AS latest_assignment_status,
    last_aa.from_user_id AS latest_assignment_from_user_id,
    last_aa.from_department_id AS latest_assignment_from_department_id,
    last_aa.to_user_id AS latest_assignment_to_user_id,
    last_aa.to_department_id AS latest_assignment_to_department_id,
    a.assigned_user_id AS assigned_id,
    au.username AS assigned_username,
    aup.display_name AS assigned_display_name,
    d.id AS assigned_department_id,
    d.name AS assigned_department_name,
    lead_u.id AS child_manager_user_id,
    lead_u.username AS child_manager_username,
    lead_up.display_name AS child_manager_display_name
   FROM ((((((assets a
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT aa.id,
            aa.assignment_type,
            aa.status,
            aa.from_user_id,
            aa.from_department_id,
            aa.to_user_id,
            aa.to_department_id
           FROM asset_assignments aa
          WHERE (aa.asset_id = a.id)
          ORDER BY aa.created_at DESC, aa.id DESC
         LIMIT 1) last_aa ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN users au ON ((au.id = a.assigned_user_id)))
     LEFT JOIN user_profiles aup ON ((aup.user_id = au.id)))

routines.argument_data_types: p_tenant_id bigint, p_user_id bigint, p_permission_code character varying
routines.source_code:
DECLARE
    v_tenant_id BIGINT;
    v_has_permission BOOLEAN;
BEGIN
    v_tenant_id := p_tenant_id;

    IF v_tenant_id IS NULL THEN
        SELECT id
        INTO v_tenant_id
        FROM public.tenants
        WHERE is_default = TRUE
          AND is_deleted = FALSE
        ORDER BY id
        LIMIT 1;
    END IF;

    IF v_tenant_id IS NULL THEN
        RETURN FALSE;
    END IF;

    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.tenant_user_memberships membership
        WHERE membership.tenant_id = v_tenant_id
          AND membership.user_id = p_user_id
          AND membership.status = 'active'
          AND membership.is_deleted = FALSE
    ) THEN
        RETURN FALSE;
    END IF;

    SELECT COALESCE(up.is_granted, FALSE)
    INTO v_has_permission
    FROM public.user_permissions up
    JOIN public.permissions p ON p.id = up.permission_id
    WHERE up.tenant_id = v_tenant_id
      AND up.user_id = p_user_id
      AND p.code = p_permission_code
    LIMIT 1;

    IF FOUND THEN
        RETURN v_has_permission;
    END IF;

    SELECT COALESCE(BOOL_OR(rp.is_granted), FALSE)
    INTO v_has_permission
    FROM public.user_role_assignments ura
    JOIN public.roles r
      ON r.id = ura.role_id
     AND r.tenant_id = ura.tenant_id
    JOIN public.role_permissions rp
      ON rp.role_id = r.id
     AND rp.tenant_id = ura.tenant_id
    JOIN public.permissions p ON p.id = rp.permission_id
    WHERE ura.tenant_id = v_tenant_id
      AND ura.user_id = p_user_id
      AND r.is_active = TRUE
      AND p.code = p_permission_code
      AND rp.is_granted = TRUE;

    RETURN COALESCE(v_has_permission, FALSE);
END;
